candidates.title: Provide standard report types
candidates.statement: The system shall provide the following report types: circulation (checkouts, check-ins, renewals), item (inventory, weeding, missing), patron (demographics, inactive accounts), financial (fines, payments), hold (placed, filled, stale), and custom/on-demand reports.
candidates.source_quote: Circulation reports (checkouts, check-ins, renewals): 78% ... Item reports (inventory, weeding, missing): 65% ... Patron reports (demographics, inactive accounts): 52% ... Financial reports (fines, payments): 34% ... Hold reports (placed, filled, stale): 41% ... Custom/on-demand reports: 29%

candidates.title: Group transactions by dimensions
candidates.statement: The system shall allow grouping transactions by hour, terminal, branch, and system.
candidates.source_quote: Transactions can be grouped by hour, terminal, branch, and system.

candidates.title: Include transaction types in reports
candidates.statement: The system shall include transaction types such as check-ins, check-outs, fines collected, and patron registrations in transaction reports.
candidates.source_quote: Transactions include check-ins, check-outs, fines collected, patron registrations, etc.

candidates.title: Break down check-ins by method
candidates.statement: The system shall break down check-in counts by method, at least including book drop, terminal, and self-service.
candidates.source_quote: "I need to see check-in counts broken down by method - book drop vs terminal vs self-service"

candidates.title: Count check-out types separately
candidates.statement: The system shall count and report check-out types separately, including staff checkout, self checkout, staff renewal, self checkout renewal, online renewal, and OPAC renewal.
candidates.source_quote: "Check-out types should be counted separately - staff checkout, self checkout, staff renewal, self checkout renewal, online renewal, OPAC renewal"

candidates.title: Report holds by placement method
candidates.statement: The system shall report holds with the method of placement identified, at least including at staff desk, at public computer, or remotely.
candidates.source_quote: "Holds reports should show how the hold was placed - at staff desk, at public computer, or remotely"

candidates.title: Totals by patron/library/group/system/county
candidates.statement: The system shall provide total transactions reports aggregated per patron, per library, per group of libraries, per system, and per county.
candidates.source_quote: "Need total transactions report - per patron, per library, per system"

candidates.title: Transaction history retention configuration
candidates.statement: The system shall maintain transaction history for a configurable number of days, and shall retain monthly and annual aggregates indefinitely.
candidates.source_quote: Transaction history maintained for X days (configurable), with monthly and annual aggregates retained indefinitely.

candidates.title: Demographic reporting by region and age
candidates.statement: The system shall produce demographic statistics including transactions by geographical regions, zip codes, and age ranges.
candidates.source_quote: Transactions by geographical regions ... Transactions by age ranges ... Age ranges and zip codes are most useful.

candidates.title: Anonymize demographic data
candidates.statement: The system shall anonymize demographic statistics and shall not expose personally identifiable information in demographic reports.
candidates.source_quote: Demographic statistics (must be anonymized - no personally identifiable info)

candidates.title: Patron behavior statistics and predictions
candidates.statement: The system shall produce statistics to understand and predict patron behavior and use of materials, including metrics such as how quickly books are returned, renewal rates, percent of check-outs that are renewals, and probability of renewal.
candidates.source_quote: "We need to predict patron behavior. How likely is a book to be renewed? What percent of check-outs are renewals?"

candidates.title: Create and run report templates (admin)
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to create report templates which can be run as-is or modified.
candidates.source_quote: Report templates can be created by administrators and run as-is or modified.

candidates.title: Fine-grained report permissions
candidates.statement: The system shall provide fine-grained permissions to control which users can create, clone, modify, and run specific reports.
candidates.source_quote: Fine-grained permissions (who can create/run what): 76% ... Fine-grained permissions limit who can create and clone reports.

candidates.title: Shared report folders with run permissions
candidates.statement: The system shall provide shared report folders that allow or disallow specific staff from running particular reports.
candidates.source_quote: Shared folders to allow/disallow staff from running specific reports.

candidates.title: Report queue visibility
candidates.statement: The system shall show users where their report is in the processing queue (report queue visibility).
candidates.source_quote: Report queue visibility (where my report is in the queue): 68% ... Ability to see where your report is in the queue.

candidates.title: Multiple output formats
candidates.statement: The system shall export reports in multiple output formats including Excel, CSV, and HTML.
candidates.source_quote: Multiple output formats (Excel, CSV, HTML): 61%

candidates.title: Pivot table output
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an option to output report data in pivot-table-compatible format.
candidates.source_quote: "Pivot table output would be great"

candidates.title: Email delivery of reports
candidates.statement: The system shall support email delivery of reports to designated recipients.
candidates.source_quote: Email delivery of reports: 45%

candidates.title: Schedule recurring reports
candidates.statement: The system shall allow scheduling of recurring reports.
candidates.source_quote: Ability to schedule recurring reports: 52%

candidates.title: Cancel scheduled or running report
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users or administrators to cancel a scheduled or currently running report.
candidates.source_quote: "Ability to cancel a scheduled or running report"

candidates.title: Real-time reporting capability
candidates.statement: The system shall provide real-time reporting capabilities for busy periods.
candidates.source_quote: "Real-time reporting for busy periods"

candidates.title: Report performance under load
candidates.statement: The system shall execute reports with acceptable performance during busy hours and minimize long run-times under peak load.
candidates.source_quote: "Reports take too long to run during busy hours"

candidates.title: Usable reports interface
candidates.statement: The system shall provide an intuitive reports interface that makes it easy for users to find and run the reports they need.
candidates.source_quote: "The interface is confusing - I can't find the reports I need"

candidates.title: Excel export deduplication
candidates.statement: The system shall provide exports to Excel without producing excessive duplicate rows or shall offer an option to deduplicate exported rows.
candidates.source_quote: "I need to export to Excel but the data has too many duplicate rows"

candidates.title: Flexible field filtering
candidates.statement: The system shall provide filtering on all relevant report fields, including fields users currently cannot filter by.
candidates.source_quote: "Can't filter by some fields that should be available"

candidates.title: MARC field extraction and single-row layout
candidates.statement: The system shall allow selection and extraction of specific MARC fields in reports and present them in a single-row per record format rather than spread across multiple rows.
candidates.source_quote: "Need to pull specific MARC fields but they're spread across multiple rows"

candidates.title: Support custom/local reports
candidates.statement: The system shall support creation and use of custom or local reports such as collection development reports, program attendance tracking, and staff productivity reports (including time spent per transaction).
candidates.source_quote: Yes: 38% ... Among those who use custom reports, the most common are: Collection development reports; Program attendance tracking; Staff productivity reports (time spent per transaction)

candidates.title: Query for candidate materials
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a query capability for candidate materials.
candidates.source_quote: Query for candidate materials: 44%

candidates.title: Save and reuse queries
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to save queries for repeated use and to reuse saved queries.
candidates.source_quote: Save queries for repeated use: 58% ... Ability to save and reuse queries: 73%

candidates.title: Manual selection from query results
candidates.statement: The system shall allow users to manually select records from query results.
candidates.source_quote: Manually select from query results: 39%

candidates.title: Change records to move item location
candidates.statement: The system shall allow administrators to change records to move items to a new location.
candidates.source_quote: Change records to move items to new location: 31%

candidates.title: Revert item location changes
candidates.statement: The system shall allow reverting items to their original location after a change.
candidates.source_quote: Revert items to original location: 18%

candidates.title: Count and track record deletions
candidates.statement: The system shall count and track record deletions and provide reports of deletion activity.
candidates.source_quote: Count and track record deletions: 27%

candidates.title: Include nulls and blanks in results
candidates.statement: The system shall include all null and blank fields in report results when present.
candidates.source_quote: "All nulls and blank fields must be included in results"

candidates.title: Snapshot bills historical report
candidates.statement: The system shall provide a snapshot bills report that can show billing data as of historical dates.
candidates.source_quote: "Need a snapshot bills report going back in time"

candidates.title: Show last circulation date on item reports
candidates.statement: The system shall indicate the last circulation date on item reports.
candidates.source_quote: "Ability to indicate last circulation date on item reports"

candidates.title: Exclude renewals from check-in date/time
candidates.statement: The system shall ensure check-in date/time values do not include renewals (i.e., renewals must be recorded distinctly and not treated as check-ins).
candidates.source_quote: "Checkin date/time should not include renewals"
